title: Angle-Time Intensity Scope
text: Angle-time intensity scope, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Angle label} sets Angle-axis label ’Angle; {Angle offset (degree)}, {Angle resolution (degree)} sets the angle difference between samples, {Time span (s)} sets the time span of display, {Time resolution (s)} sets the time difference between rows, {Grid} shows Cartesian grid overlay, {Ticks} shows tick value labels, {Time label} sets the time axis label, {Title} sets the window title Angle vs. Time and {Colorbar label}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input data real-valued length- M vector

params.name: Angle resolution (degree)
params.values: Angle difference between samples 1.0 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Grid
params.values: Show Cartesian grid overlay on (default) | off

params.name: Ticks
params.values: Show tick value labels on (default) | off

params.name: Title
params.values: Window title Angle vs. Time’ (default) | string
